title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1915: Chaos race (1)

section.p: Flee! These opponents were too strong!
That was Blood Dragon Marquis’ sole thought.

Three Daofuses had been killed instantly. This was unimaginable. This signified that there were experts who were overwhelmingly stronger among them. Otherwise, Daofuses wouldn’t die so easily. They should have been able to put up some resistance before dying.

But that wasn’t the case. They had died almost instantly. That was too fast. Furthermore, the attackers had the ability to teleport. The distance between the three cities was large enough that not even a heavenly king could cover that distance so quickly.
Who were the attackers?
Next, he received his answer.
Up above the city on the dragon neck, a furious golden dragon appeared. While sweeping his tail around, he roared, “Stable Army Marquis! It’s Stable Army Marquis!”
Stable Army Marquis!
Blood Dragon Marquis, who was fighting Lan Tian, was shocked. The attackers were those mysterious individuals!
Damn it! It was them!

At the same time, the aura of Administrator Chong Ming surged. Waves of power rippled out from him as he started his advancement. He was already capable of advancement long ago, but he had not dared to attempt it for fear of attracting too much attention. Finally, he could do so without fear.
Golden Dragon Marquis was already under their suppression. The entire dragon race was under their suppression. Nobody could stop his advancement.
Blood Dragon Marquis glared at the direction of the dragon neck, gnashed his teeth, and roared again, “Flee!”
That was the only thing they could do.

He could feel the auras of the phoenixes. They were coming. But these attackers were too fast. Even Phoenix Mountain Marquis, the pseudo king of the phoenixes, needed three minutes to reach the dragon tail from the phoenix head. That was the fastest speed possible. And he had to use all his strength to move that fast.

No matter what, there was a distance between the two races. They couldn’t stick fully together. After all, there was risk involved in that. No matter how close they were, each race would be wary of a different race.

Now, that very wariness had become an obstacle for the phoenixes to help the dragons in time. Could the dragons even last three minutes? Could the others apart from Blood Dragon Marquis survive that long? There was also the travel time from the dragon tail to the dragon head to take into consideration.
Crimson qi surged around Blood Dragon Marquis as he roared and tore Lan Tian apart with his claws. But immediately after, another Lan Tian appeared.
The new Lan Tian was glowing with the radiance of a saint. With a gentle expression, he said, “My people, become one with me. I am all life. All life is me.”
All-life dao.
Finally, the all-life dao was showcasing its actual prowess.
Blood Dragon Marquis could feel his dao being suppressed. At the same time, something was seemingly trying to assimilate his dao. Countless strands of power invaded his dao.
At the same time, Blood Dragon Marquis was blanking out. This warmth…
It reminded him of his mother.
No, it reminded him of his time when he was still an egg.
He felt as though he had returned to that time, when he was innocent and without stress.
“Return to my embrace.”
Lan Tian maintained his gentle smile as he glowed like a saint. He was all life. All life was hiim. They were one and the same. Blood Dragon Marquis shook his head and roared abruptly.
Above him, a manifested blood dragon roared as well.
No!
Dao interference! This opponent was interfering with his dao!

As he struggled, Lan Tian’s dao power formed a net before wrapping around his dao projection. He emanated all sorts of emotions. He was gentle. He was strict. He was rebuking a naughty child. As though he was a strict father berating a naughty child.
“Blood Dragon, how can you do this?”
Countless draconic Lan Tians appeared. One of them said sternly, “Be good!”
One of them roared furiously, “Audacious! How dare you disrespect your ancestor?”
“Impudent! Surrender!”
“Big Brother Blood Dragon, don’t fight anymore. Be good, won’t you?”
“Daddy Blood Dragon, stop fighting. I’m scared…”
One Lan Tian after another shouted at him, and strand after strand of dao power invaded his dao.
Blood Dragon Marquis. A powerful dragon at the level of a heavenly king. Yet he was completely helpless. His expression changed repeatedly, alternating between confusion, fear, fury, love, and so on.

He couldn’t even roar anymore. He could only shake his head repeatedly as he tried to resist the interference. As of this moment, the prowess of this all-life dao was fully displayed. The countless Lan Tians approached the dragon slowly. When they were near enough, they attacked abruptly.
With a series of rumbles, Blood Dragon Marquis was dealt numerous injuries.
“Roar!”
With a painful roar, Blood Dragon Marquis regained his clarity of mind. He roared with pain and fear, “Kill! Kill him!”

He wasn’t speaking to Lan Tian. Rather, he was ordering the Eternals in the city below him. A race as powerful as the dragon race naturally had numerous Eternals. After all, even someone like Stable Army Marquis had dozens of Eternals under him.

Blood Dragon Marquis was calling for help. One or two Eternals would be useless in this situation, but with enough of them, the powers of dao they could amass would be comparable to that of a Daofuse. They would be able to do something.

The dragons in the city hesitated. Ultimately, some did as told and soared into the sky. But before they could go far, countless dragons appeared around them. They looked at the newly appeared dragons in confusion.

Then, a dragon familiar to them charged toward them and detonated himself like he had gone mad. Instantly, three out of the eight dragons who had soared to the sky died. The surviving dragons were alarmed.
They looked at each other warily before distancing themselves from the others. Were there traitors among them? This wasn’t possible. Why did that happen?
But Blood Dragon Marquis understood what was happening. He roared in fury, “Those are his clones! They are fake! Not traitors!”
Lan Tian was sowing chaos in the city.
By killing with his draconic clone, he had sown distrust and fear among the dragons.
“Shut your mouth, Baby!”
Lan Tian grinned.
After transforming himself into a dragon, Lan Tian attacked Blood Dragon Marquis again.
As he fought, wisps of chaos power started coming out of his body. Sensing his chaos power, Blood Dragon Marquis was alarmed.
“Just who are you?” He roared in fury, “Chaos power! Are you an ancient beast? Are you from the Chaos Mountain?”
Chaos power!
Yes. Lan Tian was emitting chaos power as he fought.
Blood Dragon Marquis was alarmed as he recalled something.

Su Yu was right. The higher-ups of the myriad races weren’t completely clueless. After the attempt to free Hundred Battle King, they started to suspect something. They were made aware that another group of experts was hidden away. These mysterious experts did not seem to be allies of humanity. Yet they were humans too.

The one who had attempted to free Hundred Battle King was one of them. The one who had betrayed Hundred Battle King during the ninth epoch was also one of them. Chaos power was their shared trait. This realization alarmed Blood Dragon Marquis.
It was them!
Just which side were they on?

Blood Dragon Marquis was confused. He did not want to keep fighting. Shattering the space around him with a sweep of his tail, he started fleeing. Just the single opponent before him was already too much for him. And there were more experts among them.

He had barely started fleeing when a rumble rang out. Far away, Su Yu and Great Zhou King had arrived before the fourth Daofuse. Fighting with the ferocity of a primordial beast, Su Yu tore the fourth Daofuse dragon into two.
Having torn the dragon into two, Su Yu bit down like a wild beast and crunched the exposed sea of willpower into pieces.
Intense fluctuations rippled out as a dao snapped.
Dead.
Fourth Daofuse dead.
Only ninety seconds had passed since the start of the battle.
The fifth Daofuse, the sole Daofuse without an opponent, was no weakling. He was a third-tier Daofuse, yet he was fleeing madly. In fact, he had moved quite far away from his city.

As of that moment, he only wanted to do one thing: flee. He did not move toward the dragon head. He wasn’t trying to move toward the dragon tail either. Rather, he was moving to the south, away from any dragon cities.

Su Yu’s duo was approaching from the dragon tail while two powerful experts were fighting near the dragon head. Even Golden Dragon Marquis and Blood Dragon Marquis were unable to shake them off. It was only logical that he moved far from all of them.
South was his only option. He fled in desperation, igniting his blood essence and even his flesh to move faster. He only knew that he would die if he didn’t flee. That was all he needed to know.
When Su Yu was done killing the fourth Daofuse, he glanced at the fifth Daofuse and blanked out momentarily.
Well well.
How fast.
That fellow had moved so far in such a short time.

If he gave chase, it would take him two to three minutes to catch up. Even Great Zhou King would need perhaps two teleportations to reach that escaping dragon. And they would probably need more time to kill that dragon. They might end up wasting five to six minutes on that dragon alone.
That…was too much time.
With a chuckle, Su Yu looked at Great Zhou King and said, “Golden Dragon Marquis.”

Great Zhou King had already predicted this. Yes, they could catch and kill that dragon. But it would take too much time. Unexpected variables might appear. Thus, it was better for them to let that dragon be. After three teleportations in a row, the two reached the dragon neck.

There, Golden Dragon Marquis was roaring madly. He was facing five Daofuses alone. He might be powerful, but Stable Army Marquis was no pushover either. Fortunately for the dragon marquis, September had been holding back to keep his identity hidden. Otherwise, the dragon marquis would have suffered even more.

Sensing the arrival of more people, despair flickered in his eyes. They were here. Too fast. Before he could even break free from the five experts around him, the two monsters had arrived after killing four Daofuses.
He could see that the two were no weaker than him with one glance. In fact, Great Zhou King was actually slightly stronger than him.
“Bastards! I won’t go peacefully! I will drag you down with me!”
Since the two monsters had yet to descend upon him, Golden Dragon Marquis’ roared with a look of madness in his eyes. A massive explosion erupted.
